title: The village fair
alt: A crowded village fair with a carousel, stalls, a balloon, a drum, a duck game and Cbear in his navy scarf by the game stall.

finds.label: Red balloon
finds.spoken: Find the red balloon at the top left.

finds.label: Drum
finds.spoken: Find the drum by the music stand.

finds.label: Duck in hand
finds.spoken: Find the yellow duck in the seller's hand.

finds.label: Tall brown hat
finds.spoken: Find the tall brown hat by the carousel.

finds.label: Bell
finds.spoken: Find the bell hanging over the game.

sounds.text: Listen for d in duck. Look by the duck game.
sounds.spoken: Listen for the d sound in duck. Look by the duck game.

words.text: Look by the red tent. Sound out red.
words.spoken: Look by the red tent. Sound out red: r, e, d.

digraphs.spoken: Search the shop. Listen for sh in shop.
